newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper drops, other metals ranged.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper drops, other metals ranged.

text.p: Copper prices dropped further but other base metals were quiet in a narrow price band on local markets on Tuesday, dealers said.
Copper moved down by 50 rupees at 12,900 rupees per quintal amid lower than expected industrial buying while sliding global prices prompted fresh offerings, they said.
Copper was down by 50 rupees per quintal on Monday and by 100 rupees last week.
Zinc was steady at the improved level of 7,050 rupees per quintal on restricted inflow, while fresh buying remained low at the higher level.
"Actually zinc prices are consolidating recent gains," one broker said.
Zinc was up by 100 rupees per quintal on Monday and by 50 rupees during last week. State-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd. hiked selling prices of zinc by 2,500 rupees per tonne on Monday.
Tin was steady at the reduced level of 34,100 rupees per quintal on fresh physical support and eased supplies. Tin was down 100 rupees on Monday and by 200 rupees last week.
Nickel was quiet at 37,200 rupees so did lead at 4,550 rupees and aluminium at 7,250 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
